title: feat(spec): ADR-0079 record display-name foundation — nameField + resolver
body:
Foundation for **ADR-0079** (record display-name contract). Makes a record's human title a real, resolvable field instead of an optional render-time guess.

## What
- **`nameField`** added to `ObjectSchema` as the canonical primary-title pointer; **`displayNameField` kept as a deprecated back-compat alias** (parse/safeParse/create map it → `nameField`, output preserves both). No hard required-refine yet (staged).
- New **`data/display-name.ts`** (pure, 36 unit tests): `isTitleEligible` (excludes date/number/select/lookup/… ; email yes, phone no), `resolveDisplayField` (nameField → displayNameField → ranked type-aware derivation incl. `*_name`), `resolveRecordDisplayName` (`Record #<id>` floor — never "Untitled"), `provisionPrimary` (designate-or-synthesize, idempotent), `objectTitleCompleteness`.
- Consumers (`objectql` search, `plugin-approvals`) read `nameField ?? displayNameField`.
- Blueprint object schema carries optional `nameField` (AI authoring).
- Single-field-title sys objects migrated to explicit `nameField` (additive).

## Staged (deliberate)
- **Auto-provision not wired** at `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` — synthesizing a `name` column would migrate dozens of title-less system tables; seam + designate-only path documented as `TODO(ADR-0079)`.
- **No hard `.refine()`** requiring a title (would reject existing metadata).
- **`titleFormat` retained** (objectui still reads it cross-repo).

## Gates
`@objectstack/spec` 6642/6642 · `@objectstack/objectql` 719/719 — green.
